tldr: Saturn through the 6th house pressurizes work, health, stress, routines, and daily maintenance.
body:
When Saturn moves through your 6th house, it makes work, health, stress, routines, chores, habits, exhaustion, and what has become hard to maintain harder to ignore. You may notice the condition of your days more clearly: what is sustainable, what is draining you, and what your body keeps trying to report.

Limits, responsibilities, commitments, and consequences may be harder to avoid. It can help you build something that holds up because you are finally dealing with the reality of it.

The useful side is that this timing can make the next honest move easier to see. This is useful for adjusting a routine before it becomes a bigger problem.

The caution: Watch for mistaking pressure for failure, or treating delay as proof that nothing is working. The risk is treating stress as normal just because you have learned how to keep functioning through it.

Saturn moves through this house for a long season. Move slowly and take the responsibility seriously. The pressure is showing what needs structure.
